integrity.proof: Exact phase-interval enumeration, sharp discrete quadratic minimization, mass-reflecting chip complementation and one-pattern full support.
integrity.reproducibility: Two independent standard-library scripts and deterministic captured JSON outputs are embedded.

scientific_limitations: Counts only labelled configurations already on primitive period-two cycles of the synchronous closed chip-firing map; no basin or other-period census.
The split-graph domain is a>=2 and b>=2; the b=1 complete-graph degeneracy is outside the novelty claim.
The full text of the original Bitar–Goles 1992 article was not accessible; historical priority is qualified.
Finite verification cannot replace the unrestricted structural proof.
title: Exact primitive-two chip-mass spectrum on complete split graphs
